resolved_conflicts.explanation: Forest Lookouts and Idaho Fire Lookouts say 15 feet (4.6 m); firelookout.com says 10 feet. The record keeps 4.6 m because two sources agree. The editor may want to check a second source.

The record's coordinates and Keeping Watch match the Nez Perce/Bitterroot cabin. firelookout.com and Forest Lookouts place the Payette tower 7 miles NNW of Chamberlain Guard Station. The story follows the Payette description.

notes_for_editor: The record coordinates 45.7027, -114.9918 are within about 0.1 mile of the Nez Perce/Bitterroot Burnt Knob cabin (us-id-burnt-knob, 45.70162, -114.990258, from NHLR). Keeping Watch uses the same point, so the Payette point was probably copied from the cabin. us-id-burnt-knob-2 (FFLA, 45.46834, -115.28288; pole tower with L-4 cab, 1933, gone, Payette NF) appears to be the same Payette tower and is a duplicate. Wikipedia lists Chamberlain Ranger Station at 45.375556, -115.200556 (not cited in the story); 7 miles NNW of that is roughly 45.47, -115.26 by arithmetic, which is about 1.5 miles from the -2 point. That is a check, not a verified location. The height conflict (10 vs 15 feet) is noted in the story. A 1936 photo on the Forest Lookouts page is credited to the University of Idaho Library, Archival Idaho Photograph Collection, but no image URL was captured, so no photo is added. The 1915 Idaho Fire Lookouts staffer is unexplained and kept as a single dated entry.
